business_summary: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated (NYSE: ELAN) is a global animal-health company selling pet-health and farm-animal products. On the h5n1-panzootic chain it sits on animal-health-vaccines: it discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K and is the listed party to the Medgene agreement to commercialise an HPAI vaccine for dairy cattle, the cattle side of the same occurrence. The link itself is scored UNDISCOVERED (impact 70, crowdedness 34, capture 40, as of 2026-09-10 per the chain's heat map) and the chain's own rationale calls it 'an option with a large payoff and an unlit fuse': if USDA authorises commercial poultry vaccination the link gains a market of hundreds of millions of birds a year that does not exist today, and if it does not the link earns approximately nothing from this occurrence.

exposure_summary.narrative: ELAN holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (animal-health-vaccines, link position 5, UNDISCOVERED, money_corner false). No H5N1-vaccine-specific or Medgene-agreement-specific share of ELAN's revenue is disclosed; Elanco reports by Pet Health and Farm Animal segments, not by pathogen.
